svg.title: Homeish options for people with two roles
svg.desc: Sample mockups: how a resident who is also on the committee moves between their own flat and committee work.
svg.text: Two hats: one person, two jobs
Sample mockups for discussion · not built
Applies to anyone who is a resident and also committee or admin (PRD: "a user can hold multiple roles").
Priya lives in flat B-402 and is the society treasurer. As a resident she pays her own maintenance bill and approves her own visitors. As treasurer she
checks every flat's bills and approves society expenses. Same phone, same login, two different jobs. The question is how she moves between them.
Two separate areas, each with its own menu. I could not find a link or switch between them in the top bar or account menu (it has only Profile and Sign Out), so
Priya has to know the web address.
Both menus are shown together, one after the
- No switching; everything in one place
open everyone's when you meant yours
- Longest menu of all three options
A two-way switch in the top bar. Each hat has its
- Always clear whose data you are looking at
- Only shown to people with two roles; everyone
- One extra tap to change hats; Homeish remembers
Stay in My home; a card shows committee work
- Simplest; nothing new in the top bar
- Committee side still needs a "Back to My home"
- Works less well for a full-time admin
Option B, plus the "Committee work" card from C on My home.
